name: animelist
description: An Obsidian plugin for managing anime, manga, and novel lists in Markdown.

scripts.build: npm run styles:check && tsc --noEmit --pretty false && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict && npm run lint && npm run architecture:check && npm test && npm run community:check && npm run build
scripts.test-vault: npm run check && npm run release:check && node scripts/test-vault.mjs production
scripts.version: npm run version:sync && git add package-lock.json manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:browser:mobile: ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-workspace-responsive.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-mobile-layout.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-image-section-interactions.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-workspace-images.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-library-refresh-stability.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-timeline-workspace.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-legacy-timeline-interactions.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-moments-stacked.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-library-layout-columns.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-library-header-layout.mjs && ANIMELIST_REQUIRE_CHROMIUM=1 node scripts/check-library-export.mjs
